reuse_scope: Generic repeating stone masonry for independent wall modules, buildings and masonry panels; not a house UV bake
dimension_qualification: Publisher width2m; square height2m assumes isotropic texels. Height amplitude80mm is an artist estimate, not measured scan depth.

N.convention: OpenGL +Y; green flip required on native DirectX import

ORM.channels: R=1(unoccluded assumption, no scanned AO); G=source roughness; B=0(nonmetal)

normal_contract: Full finite-difference height normal of the generic2m periodic scan-derived field. Intended base tangent frame must describe the nominal wall plane. Do not combine with lowpass geometry smooth normals without compensation: that doubles macro slope. Normal-bearing geometry/UV and native basis require separate proof.
conversion: Source BC/R RGB16 -> Pillow RGB8 decode (explicit quantization), BC sRGB->linear Lanczos2:1 resample->sRGB8; scalar roughness Lanczos2:1; full-height derivative normal normalized->RGB8; no house-specific bake or generated paint.
known_remaining: Generic normal/base-frame coupon test and actual source/render/export evidence; six-role whole-cottage material conversion outstanding.
